stories.title: 49ers hold off furious Commanders' second-half rally to go 6-0
stories.summary: The 49ers dominated in the first half but had to hold off a second-half Commanders rally.

stories.title: Reese's 30-16 night leads Dream to franchise's 1st Finals win in Game 2, ties series
stories.summary: Angel Reese had 30 points and 16 rebounds, Allisha Gray added 18 points, and the Atlanta Dream stymied Golden State on both ends in the second half, beating the Valkyries 79-65 on Monday night to even the WNBA Finals at one game apiece.

stories.title: Rays clinch ALCS with Game 6 win, to face Brewers in World Series
stories.summary: The Rays beat the Guardians 7-3 in Game 6 of the ALCS to advance to the World Series for the third time in the franchise's 29 seasons.

stories.title: 49ers' Evans exits MNF win early due to Achilles
stories.summary: Niners receiver Mike Evans was ruled out of Monday night's game vs. the Commanders because of an Achilles injury.

stories.title: Banged-up Rams lose star WR Adams for 6-10 weeks, McVay says
stories.summary: Rams wideout Davante Adams ruptured a hamstring in Sunday's loss to the Cardinals, and he will be sidelined for six to 10 weeks, coach Sean McVay announced.
